Mediabridge Ultra Series subwoofer cable connects a subwoofer speaker to an audio component like a stereo receiver or sound system, while offering excellent bass response & flexibility. This Low-loss, wide spectrum coaxial cable is the ideal medium for low-frequency signals produced by subwoofers, providing Deep/precise audio quality. Built with a copper clad center conductor, dielectric insulation, aluminum braiding & 2 layers of foil shielding, for natural sounds & rejection of hum/static that occurs when devices are placed near each other. A split-tip center pin ensures high contact pressure & conductivity. Uniquely gripped Color-coded molds & corrosion-resistant gold-plated RCA connectors provide a consistently tighter fit than commonly rolled cables with wider tolerances. Ultra Series cables are made from premium materials for a pro-grade output. This cable is finished in a durable, yet pliable PVC jacket for easy installs.  15g of Protein per 1 oz! Almost double the protein of other leading grass fed beef sticks

 Not all meat sticks were created equal. Made by True’s carnivore snacks (no veggies) are all Traditionally Air-dried in a commercial facility inspected by the USDA and audited by GFCO. This natural technique of spicing, mixing, stuffing and drying keeps the protein in its purest, most delicious form. Southwest Verde is our Tex-Mex twist on the OG Recipe: Rich meaty flavor with a cheeky green salsa flavor, a subtle fresh tomato splash and a mild tang.
 The obsession with the word ‘droëwors’, the Southern African phrase for dried sausage, is important to us. It is a salute to the tradition of air-drying to preserve meat for the pioneering spirit for centuries. It was and is the clean fuel for the No-Compromise, No-Fail attitude that is needed on the ultimate trail, family camping expeditions and in the busiest healthy lifestyle. Made by True Meat Snack Sticks are the ideal healthy, on-the-go snack substitute for protein shakes and bars.
 Using only the finest all-natural ingredients, our ‘Droewors’ meat snack sticks are Keto, Paleo and Whole30 diet friendly. No GMO, No antibiotics, No Nitrates, No Nitrites, No fillers. The beef and venison used is raised on a vegetarian diet with no added hormones or antibiotics.
 Proudly Made in the USA! Using only locally sourced US beef, packed with American flavors that no meat lover can resist and the great part is you don’t have to. The ‘game taste’ is part and parcel of the venison range and the jalapenos bring the heat with some naturally occurring oils. Some greasiness has been noted.
